from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Full-width horizontal samples define the periodic row-color sequence.
    rows = [(r, row[0]) for r, row in enumerate(grid)
            if row[0] != 0 and all(value == row[0] for value in row)]
    if rows:
        period = len(rows)
        phases = {r % period: color for r, color in rows}
        fallback = rows[0][1]
        return [[phases.get(r % period, fallback) for _ in range(w)]
                for r in range(h)]

    marks = [(r, c, color) for r, row in enumerate(grid)
             for c, color in enumerate(row) if color != 0]
    if not marks:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]

    # Diagonal samples encode a repeating color by diagonal intercept.
    invariants = (lambda r, c: c - r, lambda r, c: r + c)
    counts = [Counter(fn(r, c) for r, c, _ in marks) for fn in invariants]
    scores = [sum(n * n for n in count.values()) for count in counts]
    invariant = invariants[0] if scores[0] >= scores[1] else invariants[1]
    bands = [(invariant(r, c), color) for r, c, color in marks]
    period = len({position for position, _ in bands})
    phases = {position % period: color for position, color in bands}
    fallback = bands[0][1]
    return [[phases.get(invariant(r, c) % period, fallback) for c in range(w)]
            for r in range(h)]
